language.description: ISO 639-1/2 code or BCP-47 language tag (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'la', 'es')

split.description: Benchmark split label. Both splits are published and downloadable: "public" is the default evaluation split and "blind" is a held-aside subset used to report a second score on records a tool was not tuned against. Neither label is secret, confidential, or withheld from the download. For a genuinely unseen evaluation, use data that has not been distributed. The immutable v0.6 schema described this label less accurately; its exact archived wording and the correction are recorded in docs/CORPUS-V06-ERRATA.md.

transcription_quality.description: Indicates whether the transcription is clean or contains realistic noise/errors

source_provenance.description: Provenance and rights info for historical or synthetic records

url.description: A verified matching source URL when known; null for retired or unsupported citations. Read citation_erratum when present.

text_length.description: Unicode code points in the plaintext after NFC normalization, counting every character as written. Derived from plaintext only; see scripts/corpus-text-metrics.js.

normalized_text_length.description: Cipher-relevant symbols in the plaintext: NFD normalize, drop combining marks, then count code points in Unicode categories L and N. Never exceeds text_length. Derived from plaintext only.

tags.description: Topic tags, unique within a record and ordered by first use.

verified.description: v0.8: whether this is a verified, benchmark-eligible pair. The v0.6 flag did not imply an authenticated historical source.

authenticity.description: What the material is. See data/corpus-v0.7-decisions.json for the definition of each value.

pair_status.description: Whether plaintext and ciphertext form a reproducible known-answer pair. Independent of authenticity: a teaching reconstruction can be a verified pair, and an authentic artifact may not be.

verification_method.description: How pair_status was established. engine_replay: the record round-trips through this repository's engines. documented_computation: verified against a primary source by a procedure recorded in data/corpus-v0.7-decisions.json, which the engines do not implement. none: not a verified pair. Tooling that drives the museum engines should filter on engine_replay.

benchmark_eligible.description: True only when pair_status is verified_pair. Benchmarks and any claim requiring a complete verified pair must filter on this field.

source_batch.description: The generator batch label this record came from ("0.2", "0.5", "2.0", "0.6"). Provenance only; it does not order releases.

corpus_version.description: The dataset release this record belongs to.

citation_erratum.description: A retired source URL is preserved here for audit, never presented as verified provenance for this record.
